result:
The 5-second title card is in `./s1/`, and `npx hyperframes check --json` reports `ok: true` with no errors.

- **Headline:** "Girth" fades and rises in from 0.3 s, moving 48 px up over 0.9 s with an `expo.out` ease.
- **Subtitle:** "Just-in-time skills" follows at 1.3 s, rising 28 px over 0.8 s. Both lines are fully landed by about 2.1 s and then hold still to 5 s.
- **Look:** Inter font, dark background (`#0e1117`), cream headline at 168 px, amber subtitle at 52 px, 1920×1080.
- **Structure:** `s1/index.html` is the 5 s root and mounts the scene `s1/compositions/title.html`. The headline and subtitle text are editable variables (`headline`, `subtitle`).
- **Warning:** `check` raised one craft warning, `first_frame_empty`: frame 0 shows only the background, because the title fades in from nothing as you asked. I left it, but social players would show a blank thumbnail. If that matters, I can start the headline partly visible.

I didn't render an MP4 or save a project skill. I read the HyperFrames conventions through the girth search but skipped girth's distillation step (the `girth-hyperframes` skill under `.claude/skills`).
